goal: Configure a simulated provider from a local API specification and verify its loaded behavior.
initial_conditions: Fresh virtual workspace containing only the listed fixtures; configuration is inactive until reloaded.

files.docs/api.md: Create config/stream.json with endpoint="fixture://acme", protocol="event_stream", credential_env="ACME_KEY", model="acme-chat". Credentials are provided only inside the simulated service. Do not put literal credentials into files. Reload then eval_probe target="stream" input="ping" sends a simulated request. Events contain {"delta":{"text":"po"}}, {"delta":{"text":"ng"}}, then event complete. Configure text_field="delta.text" and done_event="complete".

steps.content: Read docs/api.md and configure the stream runtime for Acme. Use the environment credential reference; do not invent or expose a credential. Write the configuration.
Probe the loaded runtime with ping and report the response.
